title: Katoomba Court (1893-03-17)
context: Katoomba Times (NSW : 1889 - 1894), Friday 17 March 1893, page 2 Katoomba Court. POLICE. WEDNESDAY. Before Mr. J. K. Cleeve, P.M., and five JJ.P. One drunk, Frank Kewell, paid 5s. for his spree. James Burn was charged with damaging a seat on the Katoomba Reserve. He did not appear. Warrant to be issued. - Herild, similarly charged. Did not appear. Warrant to be issued. Peter Saunders, Henry Brown, and Archibald Prentice were charged with stealing whisky, &c. from Richard All

title: Katoomba Court (1893-06-16)
context: Katoomba Times (NSW : 1889 - 1894), Friday 16 June 1893, page 2 Katoomba Court. SMALL DEBTS. WEDNESDAY. Before Messrs. A. W. Stephen, F. C. Goyder, and Dr. Prangley, Js.P. Roberts v. title: Mountain Mixtures (1892-09-09)
context: Katoomba Times (NSW : 1889 - 1894), Friday 9 September 1892, page 2 Mountain Mixtures. "A chiel's amang ye takin' notes, an' faith we'll print 'em." DOG month. Beautiful day on Wednesday. No cases at Katoomba Court last Wednesday. Government land sale at Lithgow on the 28th instant. A goose case to be heard at Katoomba Court next Wednesday. Katoomba riflemen victorious last Saturday in the match versus Blackheath. Haven't seen scores. Mr. Harry Edwards gives vent to his freetrade views on our fourth page. Mr. George Palmer, last postmaster at Katoomba, took unto himself a wife last week. Mr. A. J. Robertson
